name: Valdecarros (Spain)
description: White field with a red triangle with its base along the fly and its apex at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdecarros (a cart on green and chequy of blue and white).
history: The municipal flag of Valdecarros was approved on 12 December 2012, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 18 July 2013; it is a flag counter-embowed in gules and argent, charged with the municipal arms.
